meta.name: lead-research-assistant
meta.description: Identifies high-quality leads for your product or service by analyzing your business, searching for target companies, and providing actionable contact strategies. Perfect for sales, business development, and marketing professionals.

copy.tagline: 自动识别并获取高质量销售线索
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速找到目标客户并制定联系策略。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically identify and acquire high-quality sales leads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find target customers and develop contact strategies.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 分析你的产品或服务，搜索匹配的目标公司，按优先级排序，并提供每个潜在客户的联系策略和个性化话术。
howto.when: 当你需要寻找潜在客户、建立合作名单或准备销售拓展时触发。

say.text: 帮我找10家旧金山湾区最近转为远程办公的公司作为潜在客户。
say.note: 会输出公司列表、优先级评分和联系策略。

say.text: 我的产品是AI编码助手敏感数据屏蔽工具，找出20个潜在客户。
say.note: 会分析产品并搜索匹配公司。

howto.what_en: Analyzes your product/service, searches for matching target companies, prioritizes leads by fit score, and provides contact strategies with personalized messaging for each lead.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to find potential customers, build a list of companies for outreach, or prepare for sales development activities.

say_en.text: Find me 10 companies in the Bay Area that recently went remote as potential leads.
say_en.note: Outputs a prioritized list with contact strategies.

say_en.text: My product is a sensitive data masking tool for AI coding assistants. Find 20 qualified leads.
say_en.note: Analyzes product and searches for matching companies.
